ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $P$ is the midpoint of side $AC$ of the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$, $E$ is a point on the extension line of side $BC$, and $PE = PB$, what is the degree measure of $\angle CPE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $P$ is the midpoint of side $AC$ of the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$,\\
it follows that $BP$ bisects $\angle ABC$, and $\angle ABC=60^\circ=\angle ACB$,\\
thus, $\angle PBC=30^\circ$,\\
since $PE=PB$,\\
it follows that $\angle PBC=\angle E=30^\circ$,\\
hence, $\angle CPE=\angle ACB-\angle E=\boxed{30^\circ}$.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $P$ is the midpoint of side $AC$ of the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$, $E$ is a point on the extension line of side $BC$, and $PE = PB$. What is the degree measure of $\angle CPE$?
ready3_open_rewrite.raw_answer: Since $P$ is the midpoint of side $AC$ of the equilateral triangle $\triangle ABC$, it follows that $BP$ bisects $\angle ABC$, and $\angle ABC = 60^\circ = \angle ACB$. Thus, $\angle PBC = 30^\circ$. Since $PE = PB$, it follows that $\angle PBC = \angle E = 30^\circ$. Hence, $\angle CPE = \angle ACB - \angle E = \boxed{30^\circ}$.

Image description: In the figure, A is above, B, C, and E are on the same horizontal straight line, E is to the right of C, and is a point on the extension line of BC. P is located on side AC, and the two line segments BP and PE are drawn in the figure; what is required is the angle ∠CPE at P formed by PC and PE.

Reasoning: Because △ABC is an equilateral triangle, AB = BC, and ∠ABC = ∠ACB = 60°. Also because P is the midpoint of AC, AP = PC; in addition, BP is a common side, so △ABP and △CBP are congruent by SSS. Thus BP bisects ∠ABC, so ∠PBC = 60° ÷ 2 = 30°. Since E is on the extension line of BC, BE and BC are the same straight line in the same direction, so ∠PBE = ∠PBC = 30°. In △PBE, PB = PE, so it is an isosceles triangle, and the base angles ∠PBE and ∠BEP are equal, so ∠BEP = 30°. The angle between side AC and straight line BC is 60°, while PE forms a 30° angle with the extension-line direction, therefore ∠CPE = 60° - 30° = 30°.
